raw_centered_definition: signed D2(h)=(d_m(beta=+h)-d_m(beta=-h))/(2*h) at exact requested target k inserted via CLASS k_output_values
repair_definition: signed D4(h)=(4*D2(h/2)-D2(h))/3; science-facing diagnostic magnitude is abs(D4)
candidate_repair: D4(production_h) uses h=1e-4 and h/2=5e-5; this does not mutate production h
local_validation: compare abs(D4(1e-4)) with abs(D4(5e-5)), where D4(5e-5) uses h/2=5e-5 and h/4=2.5e-5

pre_registered_decision.strongly_supported: Exact-target and frozen identities pass; V0.5 raw h-instability reproduces exactly 20/23 failure coordinates; control raw and repaired local max spreads are both <1e-3; and >=75% of those 20 raw-unstable failures have repaired local spread <1e-3.
pre_registered_decision.partially_supported: All invariants and controls pass and recovery fraction is >=25% but <75%.
pre_registered_decision.not_supported: All invariants and controls pass and recovery fraction is <25%.
pre_registered_decision.inconclusive: Any frozen identity mismatch, nonfinite value, exact-target mismatch >1e-12, failure to reproduce exactly 20 raw-unstable failure coordinates, control raw spread >=1e-3, or control repaired local spread >=1e-3.

authorized_next_stage_only_after_termina: Strong support authorizes only a separately frozen repaired direct-k to common-grid LOCAL validation. Partial/not-supported authorizes only a separately frozen response-solver conditioning audit. No V0.6 outcome directly opens covariance, Wm_S3, or a science gate.
